channel.title: PsychReady weekly brief
channel.description: One practical training idea, drill, or checklist for facility behavioral health teams each week.

item.title: Issue 2 / Sign-off means someone saw it
item.description: A 10-minute huddle that turns a checked box into an observed skill using PsychReady's new printable staff training checklist, NIMH's open call for comment on rapid-acting psychiatric drugs, APA's Nobel news, and a quiet week at SAMHSA.

item.title: Issue 1 / Universal suicide screening, one huddle at a time
item.description: A 10-minute huddle drill on asking the four ASQ screening questions, a new NIMH-supported study on universal screening, SAMHSA's new STREETS awards, and October research from APA journals.

item.title: Welcome / Issue 0
item.description: An introduction to the PsychReady weekly brief: what it covers, how it follows public APA, SAMHSA, and NIMH guidance, and how to subscribe.
